aiItem.title: Calibrated accessibility
aiItem.text: God may vary evidence, but every sincere seeker should receive proportionate access to a recognizable relationship. This preserves inquiry without permitting permanent nonresistant nonbelief. Uncertainty is justified only where it remains noncoercive and realistically actionable, converting hiddenness-dependent goods into a constrained moral standard rather than an unrestricted explanation.

aiItem.title: Justice-based inclusivism
aiItem.text: Because assent is involuntary and unequally available, justice should evaluate responsible orientation toward truth and relationship rather than theological vocabulary. Christianity may identify salvation’s source without making correct identification its universal entrance test. This preserves a meaningful seeking condition while avoiding punishment for sincere intellectual inability.
